title: feat: Roblox NPC apps for quest #15583 (Pollen Village, Grix)
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added two separate Roblox NPC apps for quest #15583: xiaotian1171’s Sage (#15708) in Pollen Village and tomdacatto’s Grix (#15669). Sage listens for player chat on the server through Player.Chatted, sends the secrets-store key in the request header, and returns filtered replies as both a chat bubble and a chat line. The Workspace-attribute key was removed. Players can talk to Grix within 15 studs; his Talk prompt still greets them. Both NPCs keep separate conversation histories per player and filter replies. Each app includes an HTTP-enabled example place, installation instructions, and credits, including ideas from Drjacky’s #16734 and Marcus-Mok-GH’s #15629. Builds, static checks, and Lune tests against gen using amazon/nova-micro-v1 covered replies, per-player history, the 401 path, and exclusion of failed turns from history.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art Roblox village, blocky Sage and Grix chat with players beside flower-lined paths and a tiny server shed glowing lime green (#ecf874), against warm cream and lavender gradients. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny builder’s hat and hovers beside the NPCs, small-to-medium sized and sharing the frame, never oversized or realistic, in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
